nodes.label: Alphabet lesson letter by letter (Qaida style: meet, repeat, pop the balloon)
nodes.norm_label: alphabet lesson letter by letter (qaida style: meet, repeat, pop the balloon)
nodes.rationale: Modeled on the first Qaida lesson of the daaras; after four letters: match letter to picture, count dots (drawn, not digits), trace each letter. Attached forms no longer asked at level 1. No game requires reading French; the child always ends up succeeding but the grade is the first gesture.

nodes.label: Dynamic palier count per topic (topics.palierCount 1-10; defaults CI/CP 3, CE1/CE2 4, CM1/CM2 5)
nodes.norm_label: dynamic palier count per topic (topics.paliercount 1-10; defaults ci/cp 3, ce1/ce2 4, cm1/cm2 5)
nodes.rationale: A palier is a ~10-minute session; 3-5 per topic makes one topic every week or two and 20-30 sessions per subject per year: enough to install a notion without tiring a six-year-old, whom the old rule gave 100 exercises on the alphabet. The rule is a pure module read by student queries, validation, generation prompts, admin and the trail screen.

nodes.label: Afro.tools MCP server (African API specs registry)
nodes.community_name: Afro.tools MCP server (African API specs registry)
nodes.norm_label: afro.tools mcp server (african api specs registry)
nodes.rationale: Declared in .mcp.json; structured specs for Bictorys, PayDunya, Wave. Third-party documentation, not truth about our code: registry listed Bictorys as 'planned' and its bug tracker says Bictorys docs describe an HMAC signature Bictorys does not send. Verify before acting.

nodes.label: Claude Code on the web egress proxy blocks external API domains
nodes.community_name: Afro.tools MCP server (African API specs registry)
nodes.norm_label: claude code on the web egress proxy blocks external api domains
nodes.rationale: Remote environment blocks mcp.afro.tools, bictorys.com and developers.paydunya.com at the egress proxy; Afro.tools only loads in local sessions.

nodes.label: Bictorys webhooks are unsigned (X-Secret-Key carries the plaintext secret)
nodes.community_name: Afro.tools MCP server (African API specs registry)
nodes.norm_label: bictorys webhooks are unsigned (x-secret-key carries the plaintext secret)
nodes.rationale: Not a content signature, so the code compares the secret in constant time then re-fetches the transaction from Bictorys and trusts only that answer. Treat the secret as a password; never log it.

nodes.label: Voice path never executed against the real ElevenLabs API
nodes.community_name: Afro.tools MCP server (African API specs registry)
nodes.norm_label: voice path never executed against the real elevenlabs api
nodes.rationale: api.elevenlabs.io is blocked by the egress proxy of Claude Code on the web; code written from docs, first commissioning is the first real test (check a clip lands in arabicAudioClips, then a repetition).

nodes.label: Pio walk: constant speed, 0.45-2.4 s per step, whole-sprite bounce, camera follows
nodes.norm_label: pio walk: constant speed, 0.45-2.4 s per step, whole-sprite bounce, camera follows
nodes.rationale: Body never deforms; flip on direction change, breathing shadow, dust; under prefers-reduced-motion Pio has already arrived. The bounce description predates the walk video clip described later in the same doc and in pio-animations.md.

nodes.label: Walk speed 90 world-px per second (WALK_SPEED), matched to the clip's steps
nodes.norm_label: walk speed 90 world-px per second (walk_speed), matched to the clip's steps
nodes.rationale: About two to three seconds per step; clips make about three steps per second. Faster, Pio glides; at 240 px/s the owner found it 'way too fast'.

nodes.label: Opening a new school (school, contract, director, classes, student import tickets)
nodes.norm_label: opening a new school (school, contract, director, classes, student import tickets)
nodes.rationale: Without a registered contract students are blocked by access control. Import yields one ticket per student: a login code for the child and a link code for the family. 'Rattacher' attaches an existing account (teacher in two schools) to avoid a second identity.

nodes.label: Parent activation on /register with a single-use expiring school code
nodes.norm_label: parent activation on /register with a single-use expiring school code
nodes.rationale: The code designates one child, is consumed once and expires; the parent then logs in with the email and password just chosen.

nodes.label: Known weakness: parentLink.signUpWithCode is public, unauthenticated, not rate limited
nodes.norm_label: known weakness: parentlink.signupwithcode is public, unauthenticated, not rate limited
nodes.rationale: Cannot be authenticated since the caller has no account yet; a guessed code now yields an account, not just a link. Mitigated by a code space of hundreds of millions, single use and expiry; rate limiting belongs to the deployment, not app code.

nodes.label: Student login: printed code as both identifier and password
nodes.norm_label: student login: printed code as both identifier and password
nodes.rationale: An eight-year-old does not remember two things. The login field accepts free text: with type=email the browser rejected the code before calling the server. A code student cannot self-recover; an adult of the school resets the code.

nodes.label: allowBuilds (unresolved placeholders for esbuild, msw, sharp, unrs-resolver)
nodes.norm_label: allowbuilds (unresolved placeholders for esbuild, msw, sharp, unrs-resolver)
nodes.rationale: Each value is the literal scaffold text 'set this to true or false', not a boolean: the approval was never decided.

nodes.label: ignoredBuiltDependencies: sharp, unrs-resolver
nodes.rationale: Install scripts of sharp and unrs-resolver are explicitly skipped.

nodes.label: Lowering the palier count keeps extra paliers but closes them
nodes.norm_label: lowering the palier count keeps extra paliers but closes them
nodes.rationale: Nothing is deleted: startPalierAttempt refuses them and getBucket refuses an index beyond the count; raising the count creates paliers to generate.

nodes.label: Memorization level (hifz): <=3 new verses per session, three mask degrees, closing linking recitation
nodes.norm_label: memorization level (hifz): <=3 new verses per session, three mask degrees, closing linking recitation
nodes.rationale: Same six surahs, text fades; a master gives at most three verses at once. Masks: full text, first-letter cues, nothing; word count always visible; a 'Montrer' button exists and the recitation is judged on what is said. Each session ends by reciting verses 1..n hidden: the real breaking point of hifz.

nodes.label: Spaced review ladder 1/3/7/16/35/90 days; failure drops one rung, never to zero
nodes.norm_label: spaced review ladder 1/3/7/16/35/90 days; failure drops one rung, never to zero
nodes.rationale: A memorized surah never reviewed is lost. Success climbs a rung, 'almost' stays, failure drops one rung only; verses held never decrease (a mic misfire must not erase the child's work). Due surahs lead the path; a review is two steps, about two minutes.

nodes.label: Test school seed on dev deployment (seedTestSchool)
nodes.norm_label: test school seed on dev deployment (seedtestschool)
nodes.rationale: Creates an active contract, a director, two teachers, two classes and eight students; goes through the real import pipeline because a test set that bypasses the production path only tests itself; returns all credentials.

nodes.label: pregen:invalidate marks paliers stale when the generation prompt changes
nodes.norm_label: pregen:invalidate marks paliers stale when the generation prompt changes
nodes.rationale: Cached content does not reflect prompt changes; run refills stale paliers; students with an open attempt resume on new exercises, so reserve it to development or a school-year start.

nodes.label: confirmDeployment guard: CLI operations must name their target deployment
nodes.norm_label: confirmdeployment guard: cli operations must name their target deployment
nodes.rationale: Scripts refuse to run unless the caller names the targeted deployment; reused by pregen, repair and backfill commands because the spend or the writes are real.

nodes.label: Daily missions: three per day, always one easy (G7), deterministic selection
nodes.norm_label: daily missions: three per day, always one easy (g7), deterministic selection
nodes.rationale: Seeded by student id and day key so two devices draw the same missions and a test can assert what a given day produces. Row born at first camp visit (ensureDaily) or first palier end (recordActivity), hooked in submitPalier next to the streak. One star per mission, two more when all three are done, max five per day, lifetime total bounded in profiles.preferences.questBonusStars. One parent setting dailyMissionEnabled=false hides the panel (G10).

nodes.label: Topic mastery = best average of a validated palier (studentTopicProgress.masteryLevel)
nodes.norm_label: topic mastery = best average of a validated palier (studenttopicprogress.masterylevel)
nodes.rationale: Parent and teacher reports (progress.ts) average it per subject; the 'Maitre de' trophy reads it.

nodes.label: Directeur/professeur receive initial credentials from the Jotna team
nodes.norm_label: directeur/professeur receive initial credentials from the jotna team
nodes.rationale: They change the password afterwards through 'mot de passe oublie'.

nodes.label: Expected math answers verified by computation (mathRepair.ts)
nodes.norm_label: expected math answers verified by computation (mathrepair.ts)
nodes.rationale: The model is wrong about its own answers ('3 fois 5 plus 2' expected 15; QCM index pointing next to the answer), so a right student was marked wrong. Value from the blank equation in the prompt, else mathExpression with usual priorities; fractions never become decimals; unfixable keeps needsManualReview and pending_human, rest auto_ok. 2026-09-27 dev run: 126 of 1,398 fixed, pending_human paliers 152 -> 44.

nodes.label: CI step Build (application iOS/Android): requires out/student/home/index.html
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.norm_label: ci step build (application ios/android): requires out/student/home/index.html
nodes.rationale: Runs pnpm build:app and asserts the app export contains the student home page.

nodes.label: CI step Build (site web): fails if out/student exists
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.norm_label: ci step build (site web): fails if out/student exists
nodes.rationale: Runs pnpm build and asserts the static site has no student space (test ! -e out/student).

nodes.label: Lint step non-blocking (continue-on-error)
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.rationale: pnpm lint runs with continue-on-error: true, so lint failures never fail CI.

nodes.label: CI job verify (Lint, typecheck, test, build)
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.norm_label: ci job verify (lint, typecheck, test, build)
nodes.rationale: ubuntu-latest, 15 min timeout, pnpm 10, Node 20, frozen lockfile; typecheck via tsc --noEmit, unit tests via pnpm test --run.

nodes.label: Static export packaged by Capacitor (no Next server on device)
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.norm_label: static export packaged by capacitor (no next server on device)
nodes.rationale: next build writes a static site to out/, cap sync copies it into ios/App/App/public (git-ignored, regenerated); the only network is the Convex connection. NEXT_PUBLIC_* values are frozen at build, so changing the Convex URL needs a new ios:sync.

nodes.label: Rule: read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before Convex work
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.norm_label: rule: read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before convex work
nodes.rationale: Convex guidelines file overrides what agents learned about Convex from training data; skills installable via npx convex ai-files install.

nodes.label: Rule: this is NOT the Next.js you know (read node_modules/next/dist/docs first)
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.norm_label: rule: this is not the next.js you know (read node_modules/next/dist/docs first)
nodes.rationale: The installed Next.js version has breaking changes in APIs, conventions and file structure versus training data; read the bundled guide and heed deprecation notices before writing code.

nodes.label: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.community_name: Two build targets: website (no student space) vs iOS/Android app
nodes.norm_label: two build targets: website (no student space) vs ios/android app
nodes.rationale: Since 2026-09-29 the website only serves school, teachers and parents; the student space (Pio, map, Arabe & Coran) lives only in the app. Pages are kept as .app.tsx because the app wraps the same code; next.config.ts picks pageExtensions from JOTNA_TARGET. pnpm dev answers 404 on /student/*. Never sync an out/ built by pnpm build, the app would lose the student space.

nodes.label: Numeric keypad hint and answer equivalence (canonical forms, numericallyEqual; fractions compared exactly)
nodes.norm_label: numeric keypad hint and answer equivalence (canonical forms, numericallyequal; fractions compared exactly)
nodes.rationale: The server infers the keyboard from accepted answers without revealing them (inputMode in the cleaned payload); '2,5'='2.5', '1 000'='1000', '18 m'='18', '60%'='0,6'; '1/2' does not accept '0,5'.

nodes.label: Hints are sentinel rows (attemptNumber 0), not attempts; max five attempts per exercise
nodes.norm_label: hints are sentinel rows (attemptnumber 0), not attempts; max five attempts per exercise
nodes.rationale: countRealAttempts counts numbered rows only; before this rule a hint moved the child from '4 tries left' to '2 left' and inflated the attempt number the score grid punishes.

nodes.label: ExercisePlayer orchestrator with QCM, DragDrop, Match, Order, ShortAnswer components
nodes.norm_label: exerciseplayer orchestrator with qcm, dragdrop, match, order, shortanswer components
nodes.rationale: Feedback: confetti when correct, shake and encouragement when wrong, progressive hints.

nodes.label: 'MashaAllah' bravos rotating deterministically (BRAVOS, bravo(), spokenConsigne)
nodes.rationale: Owner request 2026-09-29 with a constraint to vary: six bravos rotate without randomness so the same attempt always says the same one; bubble in Latin letters for adults, voice says them in Arabic. Quran lessons keep a sober 'C'est lu, MashaAllah'.

nodes.label: Designed for children who cannot read yet: every instruction is spoken
nodes.norm_label: designed for children who cannot read yet: every instruction is spoken
nodes.rationale: Owner decision 2026-09-28: a beginner learning to read is almost always a young child who cannot read the French instruction. Each screen makes Pio speak; a big speaker button repeats; phrases come from a closed catalogue shown identically in the bubble for adults; French flows into Arabic with the same voice.

nodes.label: 'Repete apres Pio': help escalates on each attempt
nodes.norm_label: 'repete apres pio': help escalates on each attempt
nodes.rationale: 1st miss: speak louder near the mic and hear the letter again; 2nd: slow replay at 0.7 of the same clip (no new server call), spoken mouth tip, lone syllable; 3rd: 'you are progressing' and continue. Pio is silent while the mic listens (his voice would be recorded); no phrase says it is wrong; five bars show the mic hears.

nodes.label: Voice choice: Omar as Pio's single voice (Arabic and French instructions)
nodes.norm_label: voice choice: omar as pio's single voice (arabic and french instructions)
nodes.rationale: Chosen 2026-09-28 by measurement (2-5 kHz harshness, vowel separation, scribe_v2 fidelity on all 27 verses, loudness around -20 LUFS) and confirmed by the owner's ear. On 2026-09-29 the owner heard two voices in one instruction; Alexandre's pitch varied only 4-5 semitones vs 8-11 for Omar (robotic), so Omar also says the French instructions. Spares: Anas, Loic.

nodes.label: Coach shows a still pose while a sound plays or the mic listens (animated={false})
nodes.norm_label: coach shows a still pose while a sound plays or the mic listens (animated={false})
nodes.rationale: On iOS the voice and the mic interrupt Pio's muted video, which disappeared for the length of a word.

nodes.label: 'Mon album': finished letters become gold stickers
nodes.norm_label: 'mon album': finished letters become gold stickers
nodes.rationale: The Alphabet page became an album; the four letter forms stay there 'for the big ones'.

nodes.label: Camp (/student/home): painted savanna, Pio, one resume button, missions, world medallions
nodes.norm_label: camp (/student/home): painted savanna, pio, one resume button, missions, world medallions
nodes.rationale: Tapping Pio changes pose and line, plays the success sound if sounds are accepted, vibrates; five taps in two seconds trigger a secret reaction. The resume button follows students.getMyNextStep.

nodes.label: What the module does not do (tajwid, binding trace grade, memorization certificate, class dashboard, translation)
nodes.norm_label: what the module does not do (tajwid, binding trace grade, memorization certificate, class dashboard, translation)
nodes.rationale: Tajwid needs a human ear; the trace grade is computed on device (only the browser has the font) so attempts say source='device'; no class-at-a-glance screen yet though the data is indexed per student; translating is exegesis.

nodes.label: Voice spend excluded from the OpenAI monthly AI budget
nodes.norm_label: voice spend excluded from the openai monthly ai budget
nodes.rationale: Deliberate: reviewing the alphabet in class must never be able to close math exercise generation.

nodes.label: Palier pre-generation (paliers/pregen:run) through the student's own path
nodes.norm_label: palier pre-generation (paliers/pregen:run) through the student's own path
nodes.rationale: Otherwise each palier generates on first open (~20 s wait) and the school discovers content with the child. Uses generateBucketCore (same prompt, arithmetic check, table), marks content preGenerated, runs in batches (10-minute action limit; rerun until remaining: 0). gpt-4o-mini costs about a thousandth of a dollar per palier, all elementary (~230) under a dollar, counted in the AI gateway monthly budget. Summary lists failed, pendingHuman, topicsWithoutClass.

nodes.label: MVP stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, Zustand, Convex, Resend, OpenAI GPT-4, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, @dnd-kit
nodes.norm_label: mvp stack: next.js 16, react 19, tailwind v4, zustand, convex, resend, openai gpt-4, shadcn/ui, framer motion, @dnd-kit
nodes.rationale: Zustand instead of React Context; Convex for DB, server functions, realtime and auth.

nodes.label: Device tier lite/full (saveData, <=2 GB RAM, <=3 cores, 2G) (G5)
nodes.norm_label: device tier lite/full (savedata, <=2 gb ram, <=3 cores, 2g) (g5)
nodes.rationale: The field is Dakar: entry-level Androids and expensive data. Lite decor is CSS and tiny SVG; pre-rendered HTML is always the lite version so it paints first on slow networks; enrichment after hydration. Ambient motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion (D12); touch targets >= 44 px (D15).

nodes.label: ElevenLabs voice: TTS (eleven_multilingual_v2) and STT (scribe_v2), optional but it teaches
nodes.norm_label: elevenlabs voice: tts (eleven_multilingual_v2) and stt (scribe_v2), optional but it teaches
nodes.rationale: Without ELEVENLABS_API_KEY the child can read transliteration, recognize and trace but cannot hear letters nor be listened to. Env: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID (Omar), MODEL_ID must read vocalized Arabic, STT_MODEL_ID scribe_v2, STT_LANGUAGE ara, SPEED 0.7-1.2, FR_VOICE_ID.

nodes.label: Child's voice is stored nowhere
nodes.rationale: Audio bytes go to transcription and vanish; the transcription is shown on screen, not written; one technical log line per attempt (size, format, mic peak, transcription length and script, verdict). Silent recordings (gauge never above 0.02) are not sent; recording capped at 8 s and 2 MB; mic released on stop, error and unmount.

nodes.label: Not done: session keeps focus mode, no shop/currency (G7), no 3D Pio, student Playwright tests not run by CI
nodes.norm_label: not done: session keeps focus mode, no shop/currency (g7), no 3d pio, student playwright tests not run by ci
nodes.rationale: Only answer feedback and palier end moved to the game; the answer alert hides during the 'Je veux comprendre' explanation and returns when the panel closes.

nodes.label: GameMap shared frame and camera (one transform; pan, pinch, ctrl-wheel, four buttons)
nodes.norm_label: gamemap shared frame and camera (one transform; pan, pinch, ctrl-wheel, four buttons)
nodes.rationale: World map and subject trail share GameMap; a 420-px-wide world whose height follows the step count; a dragging finger swallows the following click so a scroll never opens a world.

nodes.label: Carnet (/student/profil): cream page with stamps (level, stars, exercises, trophies, streak)
nodes.norm_label: carnet (/student/profil): cream page with stamps (level, stars, exercises, trophies, streak)
nodes.rationale: A stamp at zero stays dotted.

nodes.label: Sentier d'un monde (/student/subjects?id=): a step is a palier of ten exercises
nodes.norm_label: sentier d'un monde (/student/subjects?id=): a step is a palier of ten exercises
nodes.rationale: Topic name is a plaque on its first palier; state read by colour; the step card rises after Pio arrives; a closed step shakes its head; a slipping finger never starts a session; the student only sees topics of his level.

nodes.label: Salle des trophees (/student/badges): shelves from rarest to commonest
nodes.norm_label: salle des trophees (/student/badges): shelves from rarest to commonest

nodes.label: Four places, not screens: Camp, Carte, Trophees, Carnet
nodes.norm_label: four places, not screens: camp, carte, trophees, carnet
nodes.rationale: A child does not open a profile, he opens his notebook.

nodes.label: Fresh redesign on main instead of merging branch doums85/student-pages
nodes.norm_label: fresh redesign on main instead of merging branch doums85/student-pages
nodes.rationale: A July 2026 game world was never merged; the owner asked for a new design on main. Only Pio v4's eight poses (public/images/pio/) and the savanna decors and four biomes (public/images/world/) were reused.

nodes.label: Camp backdrop as <picture> (portrait phone, landscape tablet)
nodes.norm_label: camp backdrop as <picture> (portrait phone, landscape tablet)
nodes.rationale: <picture> loads only the matching source; two images hidden by CSS would both load.

nodes.label: July design decisions G1-G10, D8-D15 (tasks/redesign-gaming.md)
nodes.rationale: Grammar reused: hub, map, quests, device tiers, intact session. The cited file lives on the unmerged branch and is absent from this worktree.

nodes.label: Student space is a game (Monde de Pio)
nodes.norm_label: student space is a game (monde de pio)
nodes.rationale: Camp in the savanna, world map of subjects, trails of steps, daily missions, trophy room, explorer notebook. The game motivates between exercises, never during: the exercise session stays sober (focus mode, G3).

nodes.label: Carte (/student/map): subjects as zones on a serpentine trail, nothing locked
nodes.norm_label: carte (/student/map): subjects as zones on a serpentine trail, nothing locked
nodes.rationale: Tapping a world makes Pio walk to it, greet, then open; the order is a suggestion, not a barrier. Worlds come from students.getMyWorldMap (a subject without playable step for the student's level is hidden).

nodes.label: Arabe & Coran module (off by default, per school)
nodes.norm_label: arabe & coran module (off by default, per school)
nodes.rationale: Teaches a child to read Arabic: alphabet (listen, recognize, pronounce, trace), vowels, assembling, first words, six short surahs, then memorization with spaced review. Works with no configuration; only the voice needs a key.

nodes.label: Redo or add a pose (PNG, plate, OpenArt, pio-encode.sh, register in pio.tsx)
nodes.norm_label: redo or add a pose (png, plate, openart, pio-encode.sh, register in pio.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Register the pose in PioState, POSES and LABELS and in its outfit's poses list in OUTFITS; a new motion for an existing pose only needs generation and encoding.

nodes.label: Dual alpha video formats: .mov HEVC for iOS/Safari, .webm VP9 for Android/Chrome/Firefox
nodes.norm_label: dual alpha video formats: .mov hevc for ios/safari, .webm vp9 for android/chrome/firefox
nodes.rationale: The browser takes the first source it can play; the PNG is the poster while loading and the still image under reduced motion or animated={false}.

nodes.label: Keying and encoding with scripts/pio-encode.sh (576x1024 frame, VideoToolbox HEVC alpha)
nodes.norm_label: keying and encoding with scripts/pio-encode.sh (576x1024 frame, videotoolbox hevc alpha)
nodes.rationale: Makes blue transparent, removes its spill, reframes, writes both formats; the HEVC alpha encoder is VideoToolbox so the script runs on macOS. The CLIP constant in pio.tsx relies on this geometry (size = standing height, clip overflows upward for jumps).

nodes.label: Nine everyday clips: idle, hello, cheer, sad, amazed, encourage, think, sleep, walk
nodes.norm_label: nine everyday clips: idle, hello, cheer, sad, amazed, encourage, think, sleep, walk
nodes.rationale: Each pose maps to moments (cheer on right answer and validated palier, encourage on wrong answer, think while loading, walk on the map).

nodes.label: OpenArt generation platform (Kling 3 Omni video, Nano Banana Pro images)
nodes.norm_label: openart generation platform (kling 3 omni video, nano banana pro images)
nodes.rationale: Kling 3 Omni image-to-video, standard resolution, 5 s, no sound, plate as first AND last frame so the loop returns exactly to the pose; prompt forbids camera motion, added objects and shadows. PixVerse V6, cheaper, invented a zoom-in on calm poses, ruining a fixed sprite; Kling holds the camera.

nodes.label: No text in module images (generators invent fake letters)
nodes.norm_label: no text in module images (generators invent fake letters)
nodes.rationale: The first generated Kaaba carried pseudo-calligraphy on its gold band and was retouched to spirals and interlace; every new image is checked with a magnifier before entering public/images/coran/.

nodes.label: Blue #0000FF 720x1280 plate for chroma keying
nodes.rationale: Blue, not green: Pio wears green (shorts, book, scarf) and orange, never blue.

nodes.label: Boubou outfit for the Arabe & Coran module (emerald green, gold embroidery, kufi)
nodes.norm_label: boubou outfit for the arabe & coran module (emerald green, gold embroidery, kufi)
nodes.rationale: Since 2026-09-28. Green preferred to white because the everyday tunic is cream and a white boubou would blend at small size. Poses idle, salam, listen, recite, bravo, encourage, walkAway, walkToward. A missing pose falls back to the closest pose OF THE SAME OUTFIT (cheer->bravo, hello->salam): Pio never changes clothes mid-screen. Stills from Nano Banana Pro image-to-image, blue background, no text.

nodes.label: Despill keeps greens (despill green=0:blue=-1)
nodes.rationale: Default despill=type=blue removed the blue spill through the GREEN channel (tuned for green screens) and turned the emerald boubou teal; older clips keep their original setting.

nodes.label: viewport-fit=cover and env(safe-area-inset-*) padding
nodes.rationale: Without viewportFit cover the safe-area insets are zero and the HUD slid under the clock and the level pill under the Dynamic Island. Header-less screens (post-auth, focus-mode session main) carry the inset themselves.

nodes.label: Per-school activation by admin or active directeur (not teachers)
nodes.norm_label: per-school activation by admin or active directeur (not teachers)
nodes.rationale: Turning on religious teaching for a whole school is not a teacher's decision; the guard is server-side in convex/modules.ts. Students then see one medallion next to Pio on their home (no nav tab). Turning off erases nothing.

nodes.label: Student placement: level / last lesson / current surah; most advanced wins
nodes.norm_label: student placement: level / last lesson / current surah; most advanced wins
nodes.rationale: Placement OPENS lessons, never validates them (no stars); it is an adult's declaration, not a measurement. A floor, never a ceiling: a misplaced child can walk back down. Placement belongs to the school that set it; a transferred student is re-placed by the new school.

nodes.label: BILLING_PROVIDER env switch (bictorys default, paydunya fallback)
nodes.norm_label: billing_provider env switch (bictorys default, paydunya fallback)
nodes.rationale: Switches provider without a code deployment; PayDunya stays fully wired until the first real Bictorys payment. Doing nothing is safe: Pay refuses with a readable sentence, the webhook answers 503, settlements are recorded by hand.

nodes.label: Billing schema changes (installments indexes, payments.provider bictorys/manual, actorProfileId)
nodes.norm_label: billing schema changes (installments indexes, payments.provider bictorys/manual, actorprofileid)
nodes.rationale: Cumulative 3-plan schema: 14 tables and 5 indexes, studentImportRows.by_student, installments by_subscription_status_dueAt and by_subscription_index; all additive, no existing row becomes invalid.

nodes.label: Installment schedule created with the contract and reminded by the daily cron
nodes.norm_label: installment schedule created with the contract and reminded by the daily cron
nodes.rationale: Three installments appear as soon as the contract is recorded; their sum must equal the contract total, the screen warns otherwise.

nodes.label: Offline settlement ('Deja reglee hors ligne' -> 'Confirmer le reglement')
nodes.norm_label: offline settlement ('deja reglee hors ligne' -> 'confirmer le reglement')
nodes.rationale: Transfer, cheque or cash recorded on the school page settles the installment and opens access exactly like an online payment; the row carries who recorded it. Irreversible: nothing undoes a wrongly declared settlement.

nodes.label: Sandbox end-to-end payment test (contract -> 3 installments -> Pay -> webhook -> access)
nodes.norm_label: sandbox end-to-end payment test (contract -> 3 installments -> pay -> webhook -> access)
nodes.rationale: Nothing could be tried against Bictorys from the environment where the code was written (their domain is blocked), so the first sandbox payment is the first real test. Check without reload: installment 'Reglee', contract 'Actif', enrolled students get access.

nodes.label: amount_short trap: Bictorys amount is net of fees, gross = amount + merchantFees
nodes.norm_label: amount_short trap: bictorys amount is net of fees, gross = amount + merchantfees
nodes.rationale: Bictorys OpenAPI describes transactions/{id}.amount as net of fees, so the code rebuilds the gross by adding merchantFees; if wrong (fees paid by customer, tax apart, missing field) every payment looks partial and no installment is ever credited. Single fix point: amountFcfa in confirmCharge.

nodes.label: Bictorys chosen as payment provider over PayDunya
nodes.norm_label: bictorys chosen as payment provider over paydunya
nodes.rationale: 1.5% mobile money fee vs 2.25% at PayDunya on the only tier that matters for a long time (PayDunya's first tier runs to 100 million FCFA per month); both are BCEAO-approved payment institutions.

nodes.label: Unverified payment assumptions (authorized = pending, reversed = failure, no per-method caps)
nodes.norm_label: unverified payment assumptions (authorized = pending, reversed = failure, no per-method caps)
nodes.rationale: authorized card payment does not open access (prudent choice); a reversal after settlement leaves the installment settled, a known gap owned by the billing plan; high contracts may hit unknown caps but the schedule already splits amounts.

nodes.label: Trail computed, not drawn (Bezier curves sampled in JS with cumulative length)
nodes.norm_label: trail computed, not drawn (bezier curves sampled in js with cumulative length)
nodes.rationale: Gives a point for any distance, which is what makes Pio walk; tests in lib/__tests__/trailGeometry.test.ts.

nodes.label: Extending the game (subject, palier count, mission type, trail shape, Pio pose, Pio line)
nodes.norm_label: extending the game (subject, palier count, mission type, trail shape, pio pose, pio line)
nodes.rationale: Adding a subject needs nothing (data-driven, biomes cycle by index). A mission type touches questRules.ts, the dailyMissions.quests[].type schema union and quest-board.tsx icons, plus a test. Trail shape and walk speed live in trail-geometry.ts. A new pose: image, clip, then PioState, POSES, POSTERS and LABELS in pio.tsx. Lines in lib/pioCopy.ts: Pio says tu, never scolds, speaks short.

nodes.label: Generated iOS icon and launch screen (pnpm ios:brand)
nodes.norm_label: generated ios icon and launch screen (pnpm ios:brand)
nodes.rationale: Core Graphics script composes logo and Pio 'hello' pose on a sky-sand gradient; icon 1024x1024 without alpha as the App Store requires; rerun when logo or Pio changes.

nodes.label: Letter names transcribed in Latin are judged by consonant skeleton
nodes.norm_label: letter names transcribed in latin are judged by consonant skeleton
nodes.rationale: On one-syllable words STT sometimes ignores the language ('Jim', 'Cuff'); latinSkeleton compares consonants; letters Latin confuses with a neighbour only earn 'presque'. Fixed 2026-09-29: a long-i alif lost its al- like an article and was refused.

nodes.label: One letter, one picture-word (alif as asad, the lion like Pio)
nodes.norm_label: one letter, one picture-word (alif as asad, the lion like pio)
nodes.rationale: Like Arabic ABC books for children; the 28 words were typed by hand and must be proofread by an Arabic teacher, like the Quranic text.

nodes.label: Recitation judged IN ORDER (threshold 0.80 vs reading 0.70)
nodes.norm_label: recitation judged in order (threshold 0.80 vs reading 0.70)
nodes.rationale: Right words in the wrong order is remembering vocabulary, not the verse; the text is hidden so the bar is higher. After a failure the screen says where the child stopped, like a master, instead of 'try again'.

nodes.label: Who may place: admin all, directeur own school, professeur own classes only
nodes.norm_label: who may place: admin all, directeur own school, professeur own classes only
nodes.rationale: The teacher hears the child read; link is schoolClasses.teacherId, not schoolStaff (which would open the whole school to every teacher). Neither student nor parent places: a child self-declaring 'confirme' skips seven alphabet lessons and punishes himself.

nodes.label: Pure rule functions so guards are testable (repo has no convex-test)
nodes.norm_label: pure rule functions so guards are testable (repo has no convex-test)
nodes.rationale: A guard written inside a mutation would be verified by no test, so decisions live in pure modules with unit tests.

nodes.label: Hand-typed Quranic text must be proofread; Hafs vs Warsh riwaya
nodes.norm_label: hand-typed quranic text must be proofread; hafs vs warsh riwaya
nodes.rationale: Six surahs typed by hand, not copied from an authoritative edition: a misplaced vowel is a wrong word taught to a child. Text is Hafs while Senegal mostly reads Warsh; the riwaya field makes the difference visible and a Warsh table can be added. The test checks verse counts only, never vowels.

nodes.label: Math prompt quotas and distractors (symbols, words, blanks, other operations)
nodes.norm_label: math prompt quotas and distractors (symbols, words, blanks, other operations)
nodes.rationale: At least 3 symbolic, 3 worded, 2 fill-in-the-blank and 2 involving another known operation; each QCM offers the result of another operation on the same numbers as distractor: the child reads the sign, does not guess it.

nodes.label: Two-direction walk: walkAway (from behind) climbing, walkToward (front) descending
nodes.norm_label: two-direction walk: walkaway (from behind) climbing, walktoward (front) descending
nodes.rationale: 2026-09-29: the boubou had one front-facing walk clip and Pio seemed to walk backward when climbing. The map picks the clip from the vertical heading at each walk start, then flips left/right from the trail using each outfit's walkFacing (right for boubou, left for everyday Pio); this also fixed the world map where the everyday walk moonwalked. An outfit without walkAway/walkToward falls back to walk.

nodes.label: badges:normalizeCatalog one-off threshold fix
nodes.rationale: Sets missing thresholds where two trophies shared a condition without distinction; run with confirmDeployment and dryRun first.

nodes.label: font-display token declared in @theme (Tailwind v4)
nodes.rationale: Fredoka was loaded under --font-display but Tailwind v4 only generates a class for a token declared in @theme, so every student title fell back to Poppins; token now declared in app/globals.css.

nodes.label: Focus-mode cream status bar and palier-end frosted override
nodes.norm_label: focus-mode cream status bar and palier-end frosted override
nodes.rationale: Focus mode (exercise session) pins a cream bar under the status bar; the palier-end screen makes it transparent via --focus-top-bg/--focus-top-blur so its sky reaches the notch, then shows a frosted bar only on scroll, like a collapsing iOS header.

nodes.label: End-of-palier screen replaces the old victory screen
nodes.norm_label: end-of-palier screen replaces the old victory screen
nodes.rationale: Pio speaks, stars are counted against the threshold flag, the topic trail lights one notch, button opens the next palier or the treasure; on failure Pio encourages and offers to redo missed exercises; unlocked trophy, level screen and sound question chain there.

nodes.label: Students only see topics of their level (profiles.class)
nodes.norm_label: students only see topics of their level (profiles.class)
nodes.rationale: Without a level on the profile the student sees all of elementary; a topic without level is shown to no student who has one.

nodes.label: Dev database content state (2026-09-27): duplicate and level-less topics
nodes.norm_label: dev database content state (2026-09-27): duplicate and level-less topics
nodes.rationale: Only Math and French carry elementary topics; 'Fractions' (CE2) and 'Multiplication' (CM1) duplicate the programme and 'Conjugaison des verbes' has no level so nobody sees it: an admin decision, not a script.

nodes.label: Paliers expire after a term (PALIER_TTL_MS) and regenerate on demand
nodes.norm_label: paliers expire after a term (palier_ttl_ms) and regenerate on demand
nodes.rationale: Rerunning pre-generation before the school year is enough.

nodes.label: Topic completed when all its paliers are (studentTopicProgress.completedAt)
nodes.norm_label: topic completed when all its paliers are (studenttopicprogress.completedat)
nodes.rationale: submitPalier sets completedAt, read by map, camp and reports; queries also recompute completion from attempts for older data.

nodes.label: progression:rebuild backfill for pre-existing students
nodes.rationale: Adds summaries to finished attempts, recomputes touched topics, re-examines trophies; batches of 200 attempts, rerun until remaining: 0. 2026-09-27 dev: test student went from 'niveau 1, 0/50' to 'niveau 2, 6/50' with 135 stars and ten trophies for six validated paliers.

nodes.label: Single source of progression: palier end (palierAttempts.submitPalier)
nodes.norm_label: single source of progression: palier end (palierattempts.submitpalier)
nodes.rationale: Summarizes the attempt on the attempt row (exerciseCount, correctCount, firstTryCount, noHintCount, hintsUsed, starsTotal, timeSpentMs), recomputes the topic from all finished attempts (progression.syncTopicProgress), advances streak and missions, schedules badges.checkAndAward.

nodes.label: Streak (profiles.preferences.streak) and daily missions (dailyMissions) advance at palier end
nodes.norm_label: streak (profiles.preferences.streak) and daily missions (dailymissions) advance at palier end

nodes.label: timeSpentMs per exercise, capped at ten minutes server-side
nodes.norm_label: timespentms per exercise, capped at ten minutes server-side
nodes.rationale: Speed trophies and notebook time depend on it; older answers count zero.

nodes.label: MVP badge attribution logic (complete_topic, perfect_score, streak_3)
nodes.norm_label: mvp badge attribution logic (complete_topic, perfect_score, streak_3)
nodes.rationale: The three conditions of the old engine, later found insufficient for a catalogue of about thirty conditions.

nodes.label: Palier difficulty relative to the topic's palier count
nodes.norm_label: palier difficulty relative to the topic's palier count
nodes.rationale: First palier is always discovery, last always mastery, position decides in between (consolidation, deepening); with ten paliers it matches the old 1-3/4-6/7-9/10 grid.

nodes.label: End screen counts stars on exercises actually played (exerciseCount), 3 per exercise, threshold scaled
nodes.norm_label: end screen counts stars on exercises actually played (exercisecount), 3 per exercise, threshold scaled
nodes.rationale: The model sometimes returns nine valid exercises and the gap is not filled.

nodes.label: Trophy engine: catalogue conditions evaluated on a student snapshot (badgeRules.evaluateBadge)
nodes.norm_label: trophy engine: catalogue conditions evaluated on a student snapshot (badgerules.evaluatebadge)
nodes.rationale: Same computation serves awarding, the progress bar on locked trophies (getMyBadgeProgress) and the criterion text ('Valide 10 paliers'). The old engine knew three conditions while the catalogue used about thirty, so no trophy could be won. teacher_kudos has no data behind it: hidden from the showcase, flagged in admin. Dakar time for time-of-day conditions.

nodes.label: Recount from source, never blind increments
nodes.norm_label: recount from source, never blind increments
nodes.rationale: A replay, a repair or a resume can never make a counter drift.

nodes.label: Stars in one unit: best finished attempt per palier, never the sum of replays, plus mission stars
nodes.norm_label: stars in one unit: best finished attempt per palier, never the sum of replays, plus mission stars
nodes.rationale: Three stars per exercise, ten per palier ('27 / 30'); camp, notebook and trail count the same way; trail nodes keep a 1-3 grade that judges the average; a legacy attempt without summary is worth its average converted to stars per exercise on a full palier until the backfill.

nodes.label: Quran path map (/student/arabe): 30 lessons climbing from the child's village to the Kaaba
nodes.norm_label: quran path map (/student/arabe): 30 lessons climbing from the child's village to the kaaba
nodes.rationale: Owner wish 2026-09-28; same mechanics as subject trails (GameMap, QURAN_TRAIL.direction='up'); zones Senegal village (levels 1-2), Sahara (3-4), Arabia at dusk (5-6), Kaaba. The Kaaba is never greyed or 'closed'; the end is a sober sentence, no trophy.

nodes.label: Module content is code, not database rows
nodes.norm_label: module content is code, not database rows
nodes.rationale: Nothing to seed or migrate and a typo shows in review; only progress, audio cache and counters live in the database.

nodes.label: Answer flow: mutation submit -> update progress -> scheduler -> badges + reports
nodes.norm_label: answer flow: mutation submit -> update progress -> scheduler -> badges + reports

nodes.label: Original data model (profiles, studentGuardians, subjects, topics, exercises, attempts, studentTopicProgress, badges, pdfUploads, topicReports)
nodes.norm_label: original data model (profiles, studentguardians, subjects, topics, exercises, attempts, studenttopicprogress, badges, pdfuploads, topicreports)
nodes.rationale: Roles were admin | parent | student only; directeur and professeur came later with school provisioning.

nodes.label: MVP gamification plan (progress bar green to gold, badges, confetti unlock, star end screen)
nodes.norm_label: mvp gamification plan (progress bar green to gold, badges, confetti unlock, star end screen)

nodes.label: Managua: gamified educational web app for CE2-CM2 (8-10 years), francophone/Senegalese focus
nodes.norm_label: managua: gamified educational web app for ce2-cm2 (8-10 years), francophone/senegalese focus
nodes.rationale: Multi-subject exercises extracted from PDFs by GPT-4 and validated by an admin, organised by subject then topic; detailed report sent to parents at the end of each topic.

nodes.label: PDF flow: mutation create -> scheduler -> internalAction extract -> internalMutation createDrafts
nodes.norm_label: pdf flow: mutation create -> scheduler -> internalaction extract -> internalmutation createdrafts

nodes.label: Report flow: internalMutation generate -> scheduler -> internalAction sendEmail -> markEmailSent
nodes.norm_label: report flow: internalmutation generate -> scheduler -> internalaction sendemail -> markemailsent

nodes.label: MVP final status: 28 routes build, 119 unit tests (9 files), 5 Playwright E2E files
nodes.norm_label: mvp final status: 28 routes build, 119 unit tests (9 files), 5 playwright e2e files
nodes.rationale: Six phases delivered: foundations, admin, student space, gamification, parent space and reports, polish.

nodes.label: Managua MVP implementation plan (6 phases, 60+ items)
nodes.norm_label: managua mvp implementation plan (6 phases, 60+ items)
nodes.rationale: Phases: foundations, admin content, child exercises, gamification, parent space and reports, polish and integration (including role-based access control on every query/mutation and an end-to-end admin->child->parent test).

nodes.label: MVP decision log (10 decisions)
nodes.rationale: Modular monolith over separate apps (family use, simplicity); Convex for everything; organisation by business domain; scheduler for heavy work (AI extraction, emails); OpenAI Structured Outputs over free JSON prompts; internal mutations for writes from actions; integrated editor preview; Convex storageId over fileUrl for PDFs; single exercises table with status/version; studentGuardians N<->N over parentId.

nodes.label: MVP out-of-scope items: RBAC on all Convex functions, batch publish, role middleware, env vars
nodes.norm_label: mvp out-of-scope items: rbac on all convex functions, batch publish, role middleware, env vars
nodes.rationale: RBAC was 'prepared but not applied' at MVP time.

nodes.label: HUD: level bar always, stars and streak only once earned (D8)
nodes.norm_label: hud: level bar always, stars and streak only once earned (d8)
nodes.rationale: Cold start without zeros; 'Niveau 1' is a start, not a zero. Reads students.getMyStats like home and notebook; Convex shares one subscription between readers so the HUD costs no extra read.

nodes.label: Level from adventure points: one correct answer = one point, 50 points per level
nodes.norm_label: level from adventure points: one correct answer = one point, 50 points per level
nodes.rationale: Total from studentTopicProgress.correctExercises summed over topics; a replayed palier counts again (it is work). Before, only the old flow attempts.submitAttempt wrote these counters, so a student could validate five paliers and stay 'niveau 1, 0/50'.

nodes.label: Drag-and-drop repair without inventing (dragDropRepair.ts)
nodes.rationale: Model produced nonsense drag-drops (generic 'Zone A' zones, label identical to its zone, missing target). Repairs: ordering -> order exercise, calculations under generic zones get their results, word choice -> QCM, case-only target fix; the rest is discarded at generation or flagged in base with its palier set stale. 2026-09-27: 17 to order, 10 to QCM, 2 relabelled, 21 unrepairable, 20 paliers regenerated.

nodes.label: Android app target (Gradle project in android/, Capacitor 8.5.2, SDK 36, Java 21)
nodes.norm_label: android app target (gradle project in android/, capacitor 8.5.2, sdk 36, java 21)
nodes.rationale: Same static export copied to android/app/src/main/assets/public; pnpm android:run builds and launches; Homebrew openjdk@21 + android-commandlinetools on a Mac without Android Studio.

nodes.label: Capacitor router serves root index.html for any extensionless path
nodes.norm_label: capacitor router serves root index.html for any extensionless path
nodes.rationale: Undocumented behaviour of Router.swift (pathExtension empty -> basePath/index.html): every document navigation loads the root, so the app behaves as a single-page app; a redirect page at the root loops forever (white screen, thousands of requests). Android router behaves the same.

nodes.label: Export mode constraints: trailingSlash, unoptimized images
nodes.norm_label: export mode constraints: trailingslash, unoptimized images
nodes.rationale: trailingSlash: true because the webview serves files (student/home/index.html); images.unoptimized because no server can resize images.

nodes.label: Not covered: no native plugins, no App Store publication
nodes.norm_label: not covered: no native plugins, no app store publication
nodes.rationale: No notifications, camera or offline storage; the app is the website in a native shell; App Store needs developer account, app id. States 'Android is not configured', which contradicts the later Android section.

nodes.label: Lesson route /student/arabe/lecon?key=<lesson>
nodes.rationale: The bundle is statically exported for Capacitor (output: export), so no [segment] route survives without generateStaticParams.

nodes.label: Original page structure with dynamic segments (subjects/[id], topics/[id]/session, children/add ...)
nodes.norm_label: original page structure with dynamic segments (subjects/[id], topics/[id]/session, children/add ...)
nodes.rationale: Superseded: static export forced query parameters, and /parent/children/add was removed.

nodes.label: Dynamic [id] routes replaced by query parameters
nodes.norm_label: dynamic [id] routes replaced by query parameters
nodes.rationale: output: export forbids dynamic segments because IDs come from Convex at runtime (generateStaticParams impossible). Pages read ids with useSearchParams wrapped in <Suspense> (build fails without it); 'detail' suffix when the parent path is a list page. Never add an [id] segment.

nodes.label: Logout: the only deliberate document navigation
nodes.norm_label: logout: the only deliberate document navigation
nodes.rationale: Full reload discards in-memory state; landing on the root passes through the native gate which sends to login, so both platforms end in the same place.

nodes.label: Never use window.location.href for internal navigation
nodes.norm_label: never use window.location.href for internal navigation
nodes.rationale: A document navigation reloads the root and loses the destination; use router.replace()/router.push() from next/navigation. A successful login used to land the student on the storefront page, looking like a failed login.

nodes.label: Removed profiles.createChildAccount and /parent/children/add
nodes.rationale: It let any authenticated account create a student account and declare itself guardian; consistent with a product where parents enrolled children, not with students belonging to the school.

nodes.label: Accounts only by provisioning: four paths (directeur, professeur, student, parent)
nodes.norm_label: accounts only by provisioning: four paths (directeur, professeur, student, parent)
nodes.rationale: Jotna sells to schools; nobody signs up on their own on any platform. directeur/professeur created by the Jotna team (callerIsAdmin); students by the school's list import; parents on /register with a school-issued code; admin set on the deployment, outside the app.

nodes.label: Password.profile() refuses flow 'signUp'
nodes.rationale: Placed in profile() rather than createOrUpdateUser because the latter is shared by all paths, including legitimate provisioning via createAccount; profile() is only called by the Password provider's own flows. It reads params.flow because the same function serves sign-in and password reset.

nodes.label: MVP security model: admin all, parent own children via studentGuardians, student never sees answerKey
nodes.norm_label: mvp security model: admin all, parent own children via studentguardians, student never sees answerkey

nodes.label: App opening is client-side (NativeAppGate -> router.replace('/post-auth'))
nodes.community_name: Pio animations are OpenArt video clips, native app only (web shows the still pose)
nodes.rationale: NativeAppGate wraps the home page, detects the native platform and routes to /post-auth; a valid session returns the child to camp, otherwise post-auth sends to /login. Does nothing on the web.

nodes.label: Official Pio avatar replaces the MVP round-bird SVG
nodes.community_name: Pio animations are OpenArt video clips, native app only (web shows the still pose)
nodes.norm_label: official pio avatar replaces the mvp round-bird svg
nodes.rationale: Same interface for callers plus four poses; since September 2026 each pose is a looping background-free video clip, including the map walk; code only moves the sprite along the trail.

nodes.label: Pio animations are OpenArt video clips, native app only (web shows the still pose)
nodes.community_name: Pio animations are OpenArt video clips, native app only (web shows the still pose)
nodes.norm_label: pio animations are openart video clips, native app only (web shows the still pose)
nodes.rationale: Since September 2026 Pio no longer moves by framer-motion; each pose is a 5-second looping background-free clip made from the official PNG. The owner decided animations are for the mobile app and the site should not load 17 MB of clips; detection through hooks/use-native-app.ts.

nodes.label: Mobile mic permissions (NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, RECORD_AUDIO, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS)
nodes.rationale: Capacitor grants the web view mic itself (requestMediaCapturePermission in WebViewDelegationHandler.swift); iOS app crashes on first mic access without the Info.plist key.

nodes.label: Module loader: Kaaba on a slowly turning eight-pointed star (replaces the baobab)
nodes.norm_label: module loader: kaaba on a slowly turning eight-pointed star (replaces the baobab)
nodes.rationale: Shown while the map, lesson and album load; the generic baobab loader stays for the rest of the app.

nodes.label: Arabic glyph centered on its ink, not on the baseline
nodes.norm_label: arabic glyph centered on its ink, not on the baseline
nodes.rationale: Amiri draws letters like jim or ain far below the line; centered on the line they overflowed and hid their name. The tracing square places its guide the same way.

nodes.label: iOS simulator web view mic is WebKit's test tone
nodes.norm_label: ios simulator web view mic is webkit's test tone
nodes.rationale: Verified 2026-09-29: valid Opus 48 kHz file but no voice, so transcription is always empty while the gauge moves. Test pronunciation on a real iPhone or a desktop browser.

nodes.label: Verses heard then read one at a time (talqin)
nodes.norm_label: verses heard then read one at a time (talqin)
nodes.rationale: Hearing eight verses in a row then rereading them all asked too much memory of a six-year-old.

nodes.label: Vowels checked by ear: on-device 'touche le son' game
nodes.norm_label: vowels checked by ear: on-device 'touche le son' game
nodes.rationale: Voice transcription cannot distinguish fatha from kasra because matching strips vowels, so vowel lessons use a scored listening game.

nodes.label: STT quota: 80 transcriptions per child per day (STT_DAILY_LIMIT, arabicVoiceUsage, UTC)
nodes.norm_label: stt quota: 80 transcriptions per child per day (stt_daily_limit, arabicvoiceusage, utc)
nodes.rationale: Transcription cannot be cached (audio differs each time); a memorization session uses at most four, a review one; beyond the cap the child continues without the mic.

nodes.label: TTS cached once for all schools (arabicAudioClips + Convex storage)
nodes.norm_label: tts cached once for all schools (arabicaudioclips + convex storage)
nodes.rationale: The module text is finite (28 letter names, 84 syllables, ~30 words, 28 verses and links), so each sound is paid once; voice and model are in the cache key.

nodes.label: PayDunya fallback keys and /paydunya-webhook
nodes.rationale: PAYDUNYA_MASTER_KEY, PAYDUNYA_PRIVATE_KEY, PAYDUNYA_TOKEN, PAYDUNYA_MODE and its own webhook keep PayDunya usable as fallback.

nodes.label: Bictorys secrets: BICTORYS_API_KEY, BICTORYS_WEBHOOK_SECRET, BICTORYS_MODE
nodes.rationale: The private key (test_secret-<uuid>, shown once) is sent as X-API-Key; the webhook secret is a string WE choose (openssl rand -hex 32) and paste in their dashboard; Live mode has a different API key and its own webhook. Secrets are set without a value on the command line (interactive prompt) so they stay out of shell history and the process list.

nodes.label: BICTORYS_MODE fail-safe: anything but exactly 'live' stays sandbox
nodes.norm_label: bictorys_mode fail-safe: anything but exactly 'live' stays sandbox
nodes.rationale: The inverse would turn a typo into a real charge; switch to live only after the full sandbox test.

nodes.label: Bictorys notification URL https://<deployment>.convex.site/bictorys-webhook
nodes.rationale: HTTP routes are served on .convex.site, not .convex.cloud; production has another deployment name and needs its own webhook. The webhook, not the browser return, settles the installment. Answers 401 on wrong secret, 503 when keys are missing, 200 with credited/replayed/amount_short/not_completed/unknown_installment.

nodes.label: Dev Convex deployment impartial-ermine-150
nodes.rationale: Name written in .env.local (CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT=dev:<name>) and used as fallback in convex/linkRequestsEmail.ts; production carries another name.

nodes.label: Convex CLI target asymmetry: deploy -> production, env set -> development
nodes.norm_label: convex cli target asymmetry: deploy -> production, env set -> development
nodes.rationale: First cause of a webhook answering 404: following the runbook carelessly deploys code on one side and sets keys on the other. In sandbox use npx convex dev; env set needs --prod for production. Nothing deploys Convex automatically (package.json only has next build, CI runs no convex deploy).

nodes.label: workflow_dispatch trigger (manual run on any branch)
nodes.norm_label: workflow_dispatch trigger (manual run on any branch)
nodes.rationale: push/pull_request only cover branches targeting main; without manual dispatch the only way to get a check is to re-run an existing run, i.e. on a commit already pushed and already judged.
